Susvimo (ranibizumab) for neovascular (wet) age-related macular degeneration.
Susvimo delivers continuous therapy through the Contivue refillable implant, rather than standard eye injections. Patients receive two refills per year.

Approval was based on results from the phase 3 Archway study that showed Susvimo patients maintained vision improvements that were equivalent to monthly intravitreal Lucentis (ranibizumab) injections.

title: Roche nabs European approval of Susvimo for neovascular AMD
